name: coffee-sip
subject: A person in profile sits at a desk with a laptop and a paper coffee cup.
states: hand resting on the cup on the desk | the cup lifted halfway to the mouth | the cup at the mouth, sipping

name: door-open
subject: A tall door from the floor to above the head; beside it a person in outline only, bare legs, feet on the floor line, hand on the knob.
states: door closed | door half open toward the viewer | door wide open toward the viewer, its edge seen, the doorway white

name: fever
subject: A tired person in profile holds a phone to the ear; a big loose thermometer beside, coral watercolor inside. No frame.
states: thermometer low, head up | thermometer half full | thermometer full, head drooping

name: chart-rises
subject: A person in profile stands beside a big loose screen showing a bar chart of three bars.
states: bars very low, arms down | bars halfway | bars tall, the person raises one fist

name: page-turn
subject: A person drawn in outline only sits on a stack of books reading an open book, body still.
states: book open flat | one page lifted upright | the page landing on the other side

name: gift-give
subject: A person in profile holds a small gift box with a bow.
states: box held against the chest | arms halfway forward | arms stretched out offering the box, small smile

name: laces-tie

states: laces lying loose | laces crossed | laces tied in a neat bow

name: thinker

states: upright, hands on the knees | leaning forward, elbow toward the knee | elbow on the knee, chin on the fist, deep in thought

name: binoculars
subject: A person in profile holds binoculars in both hands.
states: binoculars at the chest, eye open | binoculars halfway up | binoculars at the eyes

name: run

name: sofa-typing

name: accordion

states: bellows closed | bellows half open | bellows wide open, head tilted back

name: yoga

states: palms together at the chest | arms rising above the shoulders | arms high above the head, one foot on the other knee

name: suitcase-run
subject: A person drawn in outline only runs toward the right pulling a rolling suitcase on a floor line.
states: left leg forward | legs passing under the body | right leg forward

name: envelope-open
subject: Two hands in outline only hold an envelope, nobody else.

name: checklist-tick

states: all boxes empty | first box ticked | first and second boxes ticked

name: snow-globe

states: card high above the terminal | card touching the terminal, dots on its screen | a big check mark on the screen
